chunks: Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from ʿAlī ibn Sayf, from Ḥassān ibn Mihrān, who said:
I asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about making up the nawāfil, and he said: “Between the sunrise of the sun and its setting.”

key_terms.النَّوَافِلِ: supererogatory prayers outside the obligatory salat
key_terms.طُلُوعِ الشَّمْسِ: the rising of the sun; the start of the stated time range
key_terms.غُرُوبِهَا: its setting; the end of the stated time range
key_terms.قَضَاءِ: making up an act of worship after its time has passed

ai.seo_question: When can missed nawāfil be made up according to Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding the time for making up supererogatory prayers. Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام states that their qaḍāʾ may be performed during the period between sunrise and sunset.
